_notes: Locally added for the leaderboards of VPX -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Pirates of the Caribbean.
Found by watching 164 candidate addresses (0x021108F0-0x02110B7C, 4-byte ints) through automated games: 0x021109E4
held the previous game's 2,052,520, went to 0 at start and rose through the game (final 2,359,130, including the end of
game bonus). Players 2 to 4 follow the 4-byte stride of trn_174h and im_185ve.
player_count at 0x02110900, the one address shared by every SAM game checked.
No game over flag: the leaderboards use the 'GameOn' fast flips solenoid 33 of PinMAME (score-rules.json).
